summary: General Fusion Group Ltd. filed Form 6-K disclosing a non-reliance on previously issued financial statements. The Audit Committee and Board, with auditor WithumSmith+Brown, determined that the estimated fair value of a non-cash subscription liability in Spring Valley's March 31, 2026 financials was overstated. The liability was extinguished at the business combination closing on July 10, 2026. No special situation is involved; this is an accounting restatement notification for an interim period, not a corporate action. The registrant will restate and file an amended Form 10-Q. Watch for the restatement and any SEC or auditor commentary.
